The '''Belbullab-22 starfighter''' was a heavy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] constructed by [[Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies/Legends|Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] flew a heavily-modified and battle-worn Belbullab-22, [[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:SoullessOne_ICS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Soulless One/Legends|''Soulless One'']] cross-section.]]
The starfighter was bulkier and hardier than the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] employed by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, with two rapid-fire triple [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] capable of inflicting damage equal to that dealt by a [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighter]], and two powerful main [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]]. The Belbullab was designed for a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

Grievous modified his fighter with a top-of-the-line [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] allowing the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general to stay mobile on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide scale. In order to remain in touch with his forces while flying his fighter, a powerful but compact [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceiver was installed onboard, allowing Grievous to slice into legitimate and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] networks.

==History==
After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle of the Clone Wars]], and the CIS's first defeat, Grievous used the fighter to secretly escape [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. At that time, the ship model was unknown to the Republic.<ref name="Republic Com">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref> He also used the fighter to escape various missions including the [[Battle of Bothawui/Legends|Battle of Bothawui]] and the [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|mission to Skytop Station]].

Many were used in the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|battle]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].

After his initial confrontation with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Grievous attempted to escape to his starfighter, but Kenobi pursued him and Grievous was defeated in the subsequent confrontation on the landing platform. After Grievous's defeat, as well as Obi Wan's near death from his own troops [[Order 66/Legends|turning on him]], Kenobi fled Utapau in the general's starfighter. The Belbullab was picked up by [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']].

[[File:Belbullab-22-After.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A rebel-owned Belbullab-22]]
Even after the defeat of the CIS and its remnants, Belbullab-22 fighters continued to roam the spacelanes during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Many of these ships were used as elite fighters for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] would also use the Belubllab-22 Starfighters for its forces as well. One Belubllab-22 Starfighter known as the [[Sithspawn (starship)|''Sithspawn'']] was used by a Dark Jedi known as [[Namman Cha]].
